title: Artie Shaw's $125 offer and closing
summary: Shaw offered $125, which Tizol refused as Duke paid more, and the tape ends.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: What's his name, too, Artie Shaw -- remember? He called me when we were living up on in New York -- he called me up once, and I wanted to know what he wanted, while he was playing one of those theatres on Broadway. I went over there and he wanted to offer me $125. I said, "I make more than that with Duke -- why should I leave him for that?"
What did he say? Did he bring up his offer any?
Juan left. You can't bargain with a guy like that. You just let him be.
Yeah, he offered me $125, and I said, 'No, I can't go for that amount'. Well?
